title: Why I like working from home
instructions: Ayla evden çalışmayı anlatıyor. İyi ve kötü yanlarına dikkat et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Since last year, I have worked from home three days a week.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I don't have to travel for an hour on a crowded train, so I have more time.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I can also take my dog for a walk at lunchtime.

script.speaker: s
script.text: But sometimes I feel lonely, and I miss talking to my colleagues.

script.speaker: s
script.text: So on Tuesdays and Thursdays, I go to the office.

questions.prompt: How many days a week does Ayla work from home?
questions.evidence: I have worked from home three days a week.

questions.prompt: What can she do at lunchtime?
questions.evidence: I can also take my dog for a walk at lunchtime.

questions.prompt: What is the bad thing about working from home?
questions.feedback: Bazen yalnız hissediyor, iş arkadaşlarını özlüyor.
